🎮 How to play

🎮 Controllers (best on the TV): left stick (or d-pad) to move, right stick to aim, hold RT (or A) to splash, B (or LB/LT) to throw a 🎈 water balloon, Start to pause. Plug them in and press a button. Press A on a controller here to start.
Player 1 keyboard: W A S D to move, Space to splash, E for a water balloon
Player 2 keyboard: Arrow keys to move, Enter to splash, Right Shift for a water balloon
Phone/tablet: each player drags a thumb on their own half of the screen (it splashes automatically). Tap the 🎈 button in your corner to throw a water balloon.
🚁 George's helicopter: pick George as the final boss. He fires blue Nerf darts from his minigun and drops bombs that count down 5…4…3…2…1…BOOM! Run out of the red circle, or splash a bomb 3 times to fizzle it out. Crash the helicopter and George jumps out for round 2 on foot, throwing grenades that go off after 3 seconds.
🗺️ Exploring: the screen only moves forward when a hero walks up. Walls, houses and hedges block your way (and your water!), so go round them or hide behind them. Sand pits slow you down. Uncle Luke leaves growing pools of blood when he stands still, and they slow you down too. On the beach it's boats, windbreaks, kayaks, paddleboards, parasols, deckchairs, sun loungers and fishing rods to dodge, and rock pools slow you down.
🍰 Nanny Chickens: throws cake and coleslaw at you! Splash the food out of the air. Coleslaw leaves a slippy mess that slows you down.
👷 Martin the builder: walks to spots in your way and builds things: holes to go round, wet concrete that slows you down (and leaves grey footprints), sheds and twinkly LED garden lights. Splash him before he finishes! Josie puts her hi-vis on to help him, which makes him build faster.
🛁 Bath baddies: tick "Rolls in a bath" and that baddie pushes a bath around. Anyone it rolls into gets a 10-second bubble bath (and comes out squeaky clean with a bubble shield). Splash her to stop the bath early!
🚐 Van baddies: tick "Comes in a van" and that baddie drives in, jumps out and chases the heroes. If he catches one he carries them to the van and drives off for 10 seconds! Splash him to make him drop them.
Special baddies: tick 🍬 to make a baddie throw sweets the heroes can catch (🍫 = extra heart, 🍬🍭 = sugar rush!). Give them a dog's name and their dog follows them around (and sometimes licks their toes).
Water balloons lob over and soak everyone near where they land. You start with 5, and baddies sometimes drop more.
You splash in the direction you walk. Splash the flying socks to knock them away!
Esc or P pauses · M mutes.

Photos stay on this device and are never uploaded. Tip: crop each photo close around the face first so it fills the circle.
